statement: Between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-15, at least one additional commercial merchant vessel is attacked, struck by a weapon, or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, the Gulf of Oman, or the Persian Gulf.
resolution: True if a UKMTO incident report dated in the window describes a merchant vessel attacked, struck, or seized in that area, or Reuters and AP both report such an event there occurring between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-15.
failure_condition: No commercial merchant vessel is attacked, struck, or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-15.

statement: Between 2026-09-02 and 2026-12-31, a general ceasefire covering the entire front line in Ukraine takes effect, announced by both the Ukrainian and Russian governments.
resolution: True if president.gov.ua and kremlin.ru both publish statements confirming a general front-wide ceasefire in effect on a date between 2026-09-02 and 2026-12-31; localized, energy-only, or humanitarian pauses do not count.
failure_condition: No general front-wide ceasefire confirmed by both Kyiv and Moscow is in effect on any date between 2026-09-02 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Between 2026-09-02 and 2026-10-31, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin meet in person, with the meeting confirmed by both the White House and the Kremlin.
resolution: True if whitehouse.gov and kremlin.ru both carry official confirmation or readouts of an in-person Trump-Putin meeting held between 2026-09-02 and 2026-10-31; phone or video calls do not count.
failure_condition: Trump and Putin do not meet in person on any date between 2026-09-02 and 2026-10-31.

statement: A lapse in US federal appropriations (government shutdown) begins on 2026-10-01 because no full-year or continuing appropriations covering that date is enacted beforehand.
resolution: True if OMB or OPM publishes lapse-in-appropriations (shutdown) guidance effective 2026-10-01, or Congress.gov shows no enacted full-year or continuing appropriations covering 2026-10-01 for any federal agency.
failure_condition: Appropriations covering all federal agencies for 2026-10-01 are enacted on or before 2026-09-30 and no shutdown begins on 2026-10-01.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield closes at or above 5.00 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-09-02 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 4.77 percent on 2026-09-01.
resolution: True if FRED series DGS10 shows a daily value of 5.00 or higher for any date from 2026-09-02 through 2026-10-30; the Treasury daily par yield curve is the tiebreaker if FRED is unavailable.
failure_condition: Every daily DGS10 value from 2026-09-02 through 2026-10-30 is below 5.00 percent.

statement: The WTI crude oil spot price at Cushing settles at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-02 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 88.02 dollars on 2026-09-01.
resolution: True if FRED series DCOILWTICO (EIA Cushing WTI spot) shows a daily value of 100.00 or higher for any date from 2026-09-02 through 2026-10-30; the EIA daily spot price table is the tiebreaker.
failure_condition: Every daily DCOILWTICO value from 2026-09-02 through 2026-10-30 is below 100.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: Between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-30, CISA adds at least one Microsoft Exchange Server vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry with vendorProject Microsoft, product containing Exchange, and dateAdded between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry for a Microsoft Exchange Server product carries a dateAdded value between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-30.

statement: Between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30, the [withheld] Fourth District Court orders Tyler Robinson bound over for trial on the aggravated murder charge in the killing of Charlie Kirk.
resolution: True if the [withheld] Fourth District Court docket, or the [withheld] County Attorney office, records a bindover order on the aggravated murder count dated 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30; dismissal of that count or no ruling by 2026-09-30 resolves false.
failure_condition: No bindover order on the aggravated murder count against Tyler Robinson is entered between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30, whether because the count is dismissed or the ruling is delayed.

statement: The jury in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial in Plymouth County, Massachusetts returns a verdict on at least one count between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-11, rather than the judge declaring a mistrial for deadlock.
resolution: True if a verdict on any count (including not guilty by reason of insanity) is entered by Plymouth Superior Court, or reported by AP and the Boston Globe, dated 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-11; mistrial or no verdict resolves false.
failure_condition: The Clancy jury returns no verdict on any count between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-11, including a mistrial declared for deadlock or deliberations still ongoing on 2026-09-11.

statement: The Nepal government official death toll for the floods that began in late August 2026 reaches at least 1400 by 2026-09-15. Reference: reports of more than 1000 deaths on 2026-09-01.
resolution: True if the Nepal Ministry of Home Affairs or NDRRMA (including the BIPAD portal) reports a cumulative confirmed death toll of 1400 or more for this flood disaster on or before 2026-09-15; missing persons do not count.
failure_condition: The Nepal government confirmed death toll for this flood disaster remains below 1400 through 2026-09-15.
